"You are a threat to our cause and you must be eliminated. It falls upon me to fulfill that role." $personName signals to the crew on their ship before moving to shut off comms. "Do not take me the wrong way."
OR
"Did you think you could evade us? Our eyes must see everything, so that we are prepared for what will come, and we cannot surrender to uncertainty! You will soon learn what this means."
OR
"Fighting is not the optimal solution, but it is a required one. If people like you didn't exist, the Sector would have developed far beyond where it currently is. Allow me to rectify this one issue in front of me."

"Who are you? We are undergoing routine fleet procedures, please keep your distance and do not interfere."
OR
"If you're expecting a friendly greeting, you should first make your intentions clear with Mat-Matika as a whole. What you do will be noticed."
OR
"Huh, I didn't expect someone to show up like this. Are you challenging my skill in preparation?" $personName tries to hide their surprise with a stern stare.
Mat-Matika have not factored you in their calculations yet. As a hidden variable, their fleets and markets treat you like they would any other captain.

Due to some positive contributions, you are viewed by Mat-Matika fairly above the average spacer. They are willing to offer ships and weapons at a fair price and welcome further contributions, in hopes your value will lead to greater gains.

Your name rings a bell in some of the faction's highest powers, amidst their attempts to discover the great truths of the world. You are favored in armaments and exchange, and given priority over the many others that aren't counted in their calculations.

Your value to Mat-Matika has become immense, and so has their willingness to share their knowledge with you. Nearly all non-restricted resources are available, and not even the most ignorant amongst the faction will forget your importance to the plan. You've become aware of how you integrate into some of their equations, but their greatest minds indicate that there is even greater potential to be seen.

You have become a Great One in the eyes of Mat-Matika. Your ears receive conclusions accessible to very few, and your eyes are presented with the innovation of what their theorems have provided for the Sector at large. It is clear to them that your exponential growth has major implications for everyone, and they have chosen to stand by your side to face the mysteries of the universe and  overcome the limitations of humankind.

You have been marked as a problem by Mat-Matika's inquisitive eyes. There is insufficient reason to dismiss you altogether, but you are ignored in potential opportunities compared to the average spacer and not trusted to meet basic requirements until you prove your positive value to them.

Your weight in Mat-Matika's calculations has forced them to shut off your access to their resources. Legal docking and trade is impossible, and fleets will not take their eyes off you while you are in their range, a warning that the very edge on which you stand can tip any which way, and cascade into conflict should you make the wrong choices.

You are a clear threat to Mat-Matika's ideals and goals for the future, with no second chances or reconsiderations. Their watchful fleets will fire upon you and give pursuit until their safety is ensured, exercising the full potential of their customized weaponry to defeat you. Your value has been set, but even the most stubborn of the mathematicians know that a conclusion, or even a proof, could be shown wrong with enough research and effort.

You are no different from the threats in the farther lands of the Sector or the mad pirates who dwell much closer. Your fleet is a symbol of uncertainty and danger, and there is no greater goal than to eradicate what has been shown to be impossible to reason with. In an ironic honor, you are given great attention in the faction's plans and calculations, all so that you can be be crushed and their innocent people safeguarded from your vile tyranny.
You've accepted to fight for their cause, but your contributions aren't yet leaning in either direction.
Some Mat-Matika fleet captains have greeted you, grateful for your assistance as a commissioned party. In their minds, they hope that you will join their ranks in time.

Your position amongst the Mat-Matika forces has given you a clearer idea of what the faction's plans are striving for. Over time, you've learned of their dedication, and the thanks directed your way were never brought up just from respect, but an idealism revolving around the future you all fight for.

Your crew and officers have learned the theorizing and research that made Mat-Matika the faction they are now. Your fleet operations flow more efficiently, especially when combined with other fleets of the faction, and you hear reports of surprising findings that could be used to improve your ships' capabilities even further, if only they could be fully understood.

Your potential as a contributing fleet captain has reached the highest point in the field of Mat-Matika. Occasional meetings with the faction's superiors are marked by reassurances that they were sure things would turn out this way, alongside pleading for your continued help in the future. Under that attitude of cooperation, you're able to learn about the secrets hiding within, and are urged to help in ways you've never tried before.

"Our group could never accept a request for a commission from the obvious enemy you are. You should have thought better than to come here to ask that question after what you have done up to this point. When you see our fleets coming after you, perhaps you will know what your mistakes were."
"You're already commissioned with $theOtherCommissionFaction, and as such we cannot integrate you into our forces."

"You are unsuited to be commissioned to Mat-Matika, in the plans of our wise superiors. If you truly wish to join us, you must make your contributions to the cause clear and increase your standings, so that they can be observed and accounted for."

"The thorough analysis of our great minds has shown nothing that prohibits your commission with us. I can accept your request, with the permissions given to me, but I must reiterate the importance of this decision before we get there.

By joining us in this manner, you agree to fight against our enemies in our behalf so that we can ensure our work remains intact. You will expose yourself to greater dangers in the Sector, and it is not our duty to protect you from them. All we can do for you is provide monetary support, increased in the event that you successfully fend off our enemies, and provide the munitions you need, should you have the credits.

This is not a permanent contract, however, and you are free to resign your commission. Should you do so, your decision shall be recorded and analyzed by Mat-Matika, which I guarantee will not be pleased by your abandonment. Still, life goes on and nothing is truly as it seems, so it is possible for you to prove your conviction to us even if such an event came to pass."
"Very well then. With your signature recorded here, we can register your commission in our plans."
"Thank you for joining Mat-Matika. We strive to reach a world with more certainties, and we hope you will help us reach that point."
"Strike hard, but plan harder, captain."

"No problem, discussing the prospect of a commission is valuable even if you don't find it fitting for your situation. If you reconsider your position, do return to us.

Anything else I could do for you?"

"You pondered about leaving your commission with Mat-Matika? This will lower the opinion our superiors have of you, but I'm sure you took that into account in your plans. We will no longer provide you with support if you aren't willing to stand with us, and we'll expect no help from your part in the greater future of us all.

Are you absolutely sure you want to go through with this?"

"Your commission is no longer active, and your standing with Mat-Matika has been altered accordingly. You are once again independent, captain, but we can only hope you will assist us in the future, still."

"Your commission is maintained, then. I hope your future plans are as flexible as this one was, for the greater good of the Sector and the success of humanity.

It is settled. Strike hard, but plan harder, captain."
"Mention this to no one, captain, for the other factions are not as willing to reconsider things as we are. Strike hard, but plan harder."

"Yes, it's natural you would come to us with items such as these. Although we value the human mind, the secrets hidden in them, and the potential that surges from within, has great value. If you are willing to part with them, and keep this in secret, your contribution to the cause will be rewarded."
